about.heading: About Gila
about.passage: I studied art in Moscow, then spent years in Israel — teaching high school, running my own studio, doing art therapy with people in recovery and with disabilities.
about.passage2: That work taught me one thing: everyone can make something, especially the ones who are sure they can't. Children lose that confidence early. I've spent a career giving it back.
about.passage3: Now I do it from my apartment in Schöneberg — small groups, real attention, no pressure.
about.languages: I speak English, German, Russian & Hebrew
